citation.authors: Callender VD, Burgess C et al

cited_by.title: Dry, itchy, flaky scalp and dandruff

record.population: Consensus panel of dermatologists on high-curl-pattern hair and seborrhoeic dermatitis
record.design: Five consensus statements after a systematic literature review
record.finding: High-curl-pattern hair is said to be more susceptible to breakage and to seborrhoeic dermatitis, and some common hair care practices may contribute to or worsen it. The panel says ceramide-containing products may help scalp barrier health.
record.note: Expert opinion, not trial evidence. Unrestricted grant from CeraVe (a L'Oreal brand) and paid panel, per the 12 Nov baseline file.
